column1: # Title: Building sub-type material intensity by GCAM region

# Description: Building sub-type material intensities based on data from Deetman et al. 2020. There are 2 materials sectors: resid materials and comm materials. Within resid materials there are 8 subsectors (4 building sub-types x urban/rural). Within comm materials there are 4 subsectors.
# Source: Deetman et al. 2020 Journal of Cleaner Production Supplementary Information;  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2019.118658 (with data processing for use in GCAM)
